text: Bitcoin is flat while Ethereum and smaller caps edge higher, suggesting modest risk appetite without conviction; the Fear & Greed index at 66 (Greed) and climbing 32 points over a week signals growing confidence, but Bitcoin's static dominance at 59% indicates money is rotating toward alternatives rather than concentrated in the largest asset. Volume at $87B is moderate for the current price environment, reflecting cautious participation in what appears to be a sentiment-driven rally rather than a breakout move.
